title: Harborline SiteGuard Service Levels for Malware Scanning and Expert Cleanup
content:
Each Website Security tier commits to the following scanning and malware cleanup service levels for its protected site.

| Service level | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pages scanned per scan | 500 | 2500 | 10000 | 25000 | 25000 | 100000 |
| Elapsed hours between malware scans | 24 | 24 | 12 | 6 | 6 | 1 |
| File change monitoring | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Known malware removed automatically | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Expert manual cleanups included per subscription year | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 12 |
| Fee per expert manual cleanup beyond those included, USD | 299 | 249 | 199 | 149 | 149 | 99 |
| Hours targeted from a cleanup request to work starting | 72 | 48 | 24 | 12 | 12 | 4 |
| Re-infection guarantee, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Scope of expert cleanup | Files only | Files only | Files and database | Files and database | Files and database | Files and database |
| Search-engine and spam blacklist monitoring | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline files blacklist removal requests after cleanup | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column headings are the Harborline SiteGuard tiers of the same name (Harborline SiteGuard Essentials through Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise).

## Definitions used in this schedule

- **Pages scanned** is the number of pages one scan covers. **Hours between scans** is the elapsed time from one malware scan to the next.
- **Known malware removed automatically** states whether detected known malware is removed without an expert.
- **Included cleanups** are counted per subscription year, on every tier: the first subscription year starts on the plan's opening date and each later one starts on an anniversary of it.
- **Extra cleanup fee** is the fee for one expert manual cleanup beyond those included.
- **Response target** is the elapsed hours targeted from a cleanup request to work starting.
- **Re-infection guarantee** is the number of calendar days after a completed cleanup during which a re-infection is cleaned free and not counted.
- **Scope** states what an expert cleanup covers: the site's files only, or its files and its database.

## Comparing two tiers (hypothetical)

A site owner choosing between the Harborline SiteGuard Pro and Harborline SiteGuard Business tiers can read from the schedule that the Business tier scans every 6 hours instead of every 12, covers 25000 pages per scan instead of 10000, includes 4 expert manual cleanups per subscription year instead of 2, and charges 149 USD instead of 199 USD for each cleanup beyond those; both clean files and database and both file blacklist removal requests after a cleanup.
